# Purpose
This script creates `Exercise_03.RData`, the file loaded when rendering `Exercise_03.qmd` and by students in Posit Cloud. Each run:

1. Downloads community areas, zip codes, the Chicago COVID-19 Community Vulnerability Index (CCVI), daily CTA boardings and weekly COVID-19 cases from the [Chicago Data Portal](https://data.cityofchicago.org/). Each download is also saved as a cache file in the data directory, which is read instead when the portal cannot be reached.
2. Imports CTA rail stations, rail lines and monthly station ridership, 1999-2026 ([RTAMS](https://rtams.org/media/datasets/cta-ridership)), from the data directory. When RTAMS posts a newer ridership file, save it in the data directory and update `file_ridership` in the settings below.
3. Attributes L stations with their nearest community area and zip code, and joins stations with CCVI scores and ridership.
4. Saves the datasets, along with the functions students use to create the exercise's tables, plots and maps, to `Exercise_03.RData`. The CARTO API key used by the basemaps is also saved; it comes from the `CARTO_API_KEY` environment variable (e.g., set in `.Renviron`).

Upload `Exercise_03.RData` to the course data pages (`https://justenvirons.org/pedagogy/GEO330/Exercise_03/data/Exercise_03.RData`) after each run.

# Settings
```{r}
#| label: settings

data_dir <- "exercises/Exercise_03/data"

# datasets and functions loaded by Exercise_03.qmd
exercise_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Exercise_03.RData")

# Chicago Data Portal sources
url_community_areas <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/igwz-8jzy.geojson"
url_zip_codes <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/unjd-c2ca.geojson"
url_ccvi <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/api/views/rqqg-u7zt/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD"
url_daily_boardings <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/api/views/6iiy-9s97/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD"
url_covid19 <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/api/views/naz8-j4nc/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD"

# RTAMS sources (saved in the data directory)
file_rail_stations <- file.path(data_dir, "CTA_RAIL_STATIONS.shp")
file_rail_lines <- file.path(data_dir, "CTA_RAIL_LINES.shp")
file_ridership <- file.path(data_dir, "CTA_Average_Rail_Station_Ridership_1999_2026.csv")
```

# Functions for data development
```{r}
#| label: data development functions

# download a file to its cache path; if the download fails, the existing cache
# file (from an earlier run) is used instead. The download goes to a temporary
# file first so a failed download does not overwrite the cache.
download_cached <- function(url, cache) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", tools::file_ext(cache)))
  ok <- tryCatch({
    download.file(url, tmp, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    file.copy(tmp, cache, overwrite = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) FALSE, warning = function(w) FALSE)
  if (!ok) {
    if (!file.exists(cache)) stop("Download failed and no cache file found: ", cache)
    message("Download failed; using cache file ", cache)
  }
  cache
}

read_portal_csv <- function(url, cache) {
  read_csv(download_cached(url, cache), show_col_types = FALSE)
}

read_portal_geojson <- function(url, cache) {
  st_read(download_cached(url, cache), quiet = TRUE)
}
```

# Geographic data
## Community areas and zip codes
```{r}
#| label: community areas and zip codes

# City of Chicago community areas (N=77) in Illinois State Plane East (epsg:3435)
community_areas <- read_portal_geojson(url_community_areas,
                                       file.path(data_dir, "community_areas_cache.geojson")) %>%
  st_transform(3435) %>%
  mutate(comarea_id = as.numeric(area_numbe),
         comarea_name = str_to_title(community)) %>%
  select(comarea_id, comarea_name)

zip_codes <- read_portal_geojson(url_zip_codes,
                                 file.path(data_dir, "zip_codes_cache.geojson")) %>%
  st_transform(3435) %>%
  select(zip)
```

## L stations and lines
Stations and lines were downloaded from the *Shapefiles and Feature Layers* section of the [RTAMS Maps and Data web page](https://rtagis.maps.arcgis.com/home/index.html). Stations outside the city of Chicago are removed, and each remaining station is attributed with its nearest community area and zip code.

```{r}
#| label: rail stations and lines

line_names <- c(BL = "Blue", BR = "Brown", GR = "Green", ML = "Multi",
                OR = "Orange", PK = "Pink", PR = "Purple", RD = "Red", YL = "Yellow")

rail_stations_all <- st_read(file_rail_stations, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(3435) %>%
  select(station_id = STATION_ID,
         station_name = SHORTNAME,
         station_name_long = LONGNAME,
         station_line = LEGEND) %>%
  mutate(station_id = as.numeric(station_id),
         station_line = unname(line_names[station_line]))

# stations within the city of Chicago
rail_stations_chicago <- rail_stations_all %>%
  st_filter(community_areas)

# nearest community area and zip code of each station
rail_stations <- rail_stations_chicago %>%
  st_join(community_areas, join = st_nearest_feature) %>%
  st_join(zip_codes, join = st_nearest_feature)

rail_lines <- st_read(file_rail_lines, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  select(COLOR)

rm(rail_stations_all, rail_stations_chicago)
```

# CCVI by community area
The CCVI dataset includes community areas and zip codes; only community areas are kept. One is added to the rank values to adjust their range from 0-76 to 1-77, and each rank is also grouped into quintiles (`_ntile` columns).

```{r}
#| label: ccvi by community area

ccvi_attributes <- read_portal_csv(url_ccvi, file.path(data_dir, "ccvi_cache.csv"))

if ("Geography Type" %in% names(ccvi_attributes)) {
  ccvi_attributes <- ccvi_attributes %>%
    filter(`Geography Type` == "CA") %>%
    select(-`Geography Type`)
}

ccvi_attributes <- ccvi_attributes %>%
  select(-any_of(c("Location", "Community Area Name"))) %>%
  rename(comarea_id = 1) %>%
  mutate(comarea_id = as.numeric(comarea_id))

community_areas_ccvi <- community_areas %>%
  left_join(ccvi_attributes, by = "comarea_id") %>%
  mutate(across(`Rank - Socioeconomic Status`:`Rank - COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate`,
                ~ ntile(.x, 5), .names = "{.col}_ntile")) %>%
  mutate(across(`Rank - Socioeconomic Status`:`Rank - COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate`,
                ~ .x + 1)) %>%
  mutate(`CCVI Category` = factor(`CCVI Category`, levels = c("LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"))) %>%
  arrange(`CCVI Score`)
```

# Ridership
## Daily boardings (all stations)
```{r}
#| label: daily boardings

ridership_daily_boardings <- read_portal_csv(url_daily_boardings,
                                             file.path(data_dir, "daily_boardings_cache.csv")) %>%
  mutate(service_date = as.Date(parse_date_time(service_date, c("mdy", "ymd")))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(service_date)
```

## Monthly boardings by station
```{r}
#| label: monthly boardings by station

ridership_attributes <- read_csv(file_ridership, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(station_id = RIDERSHIP_ID,
         station_name = NAME,
         year = YEAR,
         month = MONTH,
         day_type = DAY_TYPE,
         rides_total = TOTAL_RIDES,
         rides_avg = DAILY_AVG_RIDES) %>%
  mutate(station_id = as.numeric(station_id),
         year_month = make_date(year, month, 1))

# latest month in the ridership data, used to label figures in Exercise_03.qmd
ridership_through <- max(ridership_attributes$year_month)
```

## Join stations with CCVI and ridership
```{r}
#| label: join stations with ccvi and ridership

rail_stations_ccvi <- rail_stations %>%
  left_join(community_areas_ccvi %>%
              st_drop_geometry() %>%
              select(-comarea_name),
            by = "comarea_id")

# weekday boardings by station and month, with station line and CCVI
rail_stations_ccvi_ridership <- ridership_attributes %>%
  filter(day_type == "Weekday") %>%
  select(station_id, year_month, rides_total) %>%
  inner_join(rail_stations_ccvi %>%
               st_drop_geometry() %>%
               select(station_id, station_name, station_line, comarea_id, comarea_name,
                      `CCVI Score`, `CCVI Category`),
             by = "station_id")
```

# COVID-19 cases and deaths
The city's COVID-19 reporting ended in May 2024.

```{r}
#| label: covid-19 cases and deaths

covid19_cases_summary <- read_portal_csv(url_covid19, file.path(data_dir, "covid19_cache.csv")) %>%
  select(Date, Cases = `Cases - Total`, Deaths = `Deaths - Total`) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(parse_date_time(Date, c("mdy", "ymd"))),
         across(c(Cases, Deaths), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0))) %>%
  drop_na(Date) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(Cases7d = round(rollmean(Cases, k = 7, fill = 0, align = "right"), digits = 1),
         Deaths7d = round(rollmean(Deaths, k = 7, fill = 0, align = "right"), digits = 1),
         Casescm = cumsum(Cases),
         Deathscm = cumsum(Deaths),
         Geography = "Chicago") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = Cases:Deathscm, names_to = "layer", values_to = "value")
```

# Create Exercise_03.RData file
## Functions for Exercise #3

```{r}
#| label: exercise functions

# CCVI category colors
pal_ccvi <- c(LOW = "#E2F11A", MEDIUM = "#E0A100", HIGH = "#9F1928")

# L line colors; names match station_line and the rail lines' COLOR column
pal_line <- c(Blue = "#3498db", Brown = "#964B00", Green = "#1e8449", Multi = "#424949",
              Orange = "#e67e22", Pink = "#f5b7b1", Purple = "#7d3c98", Red = "#e74c3c",
              Yellow = "#f4d03f")

# function for applying the layout shared by the exercise's plots: y axis title,
# horizontal legend below the plot, unified hover labels and an image download
# button that saves the plot as filename.png
fx_plot_layout <- function(p, y_title, filename, x_title = "") {
  p %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           modeBarButtons = list(list("toImage", "resetScale2d")),
           toImageButtonOptions = list(filename = filename)) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = x_title),
      yaxis = list(title = y_title),
      legend = list(
        font = list(size = 10),
        orientation = "h",
        xanchor = "center",
        x = 0.5, y = -0.1),
      hovermode = "x unified")
}

# function for formatting a table as an interactive table
fx_datatable <- function(table) {
  datatable(table,
            class = 'cell-border stripe',
            rownames = FALSE,
            options = list(pageLength = 5),
            filter = "top")
}

# function for tabulating L stations by community area and zip code
fx_table_stations <- function(rail_stations) {
  rail_stations %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(`L Station` = station_name,
           `Community Area` = comarea_name,
           `Station Line` = station_line,
           `Zip Code` = zip) %>%
    arrange(`L Station`) %>%
    fx_datatable()
}

# function for creating the base map shared by the exercise's maps: CARTO
# basemap, reset and full screen buttons and community area boundaries for
# reference (added first, so they are drawn beneath the other layers)
fx_basemap <- function(map_data, carto_api_key = CARTO_API_KEY) {
  leaflet(data = st_transform(map_data, crs = 4326)) %>%
    addTiles(urlTemplate = paste0(
      "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=",
      carto_api_key
    )) %>%
    addResetMapButton() %>%
    addFullscreenControl() %>%
    addPolygons(
      fill = FALSE,
      color = "#555",
      weight = 1,
      opacity = 1)
}

# function for creating community area hover labels with CCVI scores, categories
# and ranks
fx_ccvi_labels <- function(community_areas_ccvi) {
  x <- community_areas_ccvi
  sprintf(
    "<strong>%s</strong><br/>
    <i>CCVI Score:</i> %0.1f<br/>
    <i>CCVI Category:</i> %s<br/><br/>
    <em>Ranked scores from least (1) to most (77) vulnerable:</em><br/>
    <i>Socioeconomic Status:</i> %1.0f<br/>
    <i>Essential Workers:</i> %1.0f<br/>
    <i>Mobility Ratio:</i> %1.0f<br/>
    <i>COVID-19 Incidence Rate:</i> %1.0f<br/>
    <i>COVID-19 Hospitalization Rate:</i> %1.0f<br/>
    <i>COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate:</i> %1.0f<br/>",
    x$comarea_name,
    x$`CCVI Score`,
    x$`CCVI Category`,
    x$`Rank - Socioeconomic Status`,
    x$`Rank - Frontline Essential Workers`,
    x$`Rank - Cumulative Mobility Ratio`,
    x$`Rank - COVID-19 Incidence Rate`,
    x$`Rank - COVID-19 Hospital Admission Rate`,
    x$`Rank - COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate`) %>%
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)
}

# function for adding one community area layer and legend per measure, plus a
# dropdown list (top right) that shows one measure at a time; the first measure
# is shown when the map opens. measures and pals are named lists of values and
# their color palettes.
fx_add_measure_layers <- function(map, map_data, measures, pals, labels) {
  for (i in seq_along(measures)) {
    values <- measures[[i]]
    pal <- pals[[i]]
    map <- map %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = map_data,
        fillColor = pal(values),
        label = labels,
        weight = 2,
        opacity = 1,
        color = "white",
        dashArray = "3",
        fillOpacity = 0.7,
        group = names(measures)[i]) %>%
      addLegend("bottomleft",
                pal = pal,
                values = values,
                title = names(measures)[i],
                opacity = 1,
                className = paste0("info legend measure-legend measure-legend-", i - 1))
  }
  map %>%
    htmlwidgets::onRender("
      function(el, x, data) {
        var map = this;
        var groups = [].concat(data.groups);
        // show the selected measure's layer and legend and hide the others
        function show(i) {
          groups.forEach(function(g, j) {
            var layer = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup(g, false);
            if (layer) {
              if (j === i) { map.addLayer(layer); } else { map.removeLayer(layer); }
            }
          });
          el.querySelectorAll('.measure-legend').forEach(function(d) {
            d.style.display = d.classList.contains('measure-legend-' + i) ? '' : 'none';
          });
        }
        var control = L.control({position: 'topright'});
        control.onAdd = function() {
          var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
          div.style.background = 'white';
          div.style.padding = '4px 6px';
          div.innerHTML = '<label style=\"font-weight: bold; margin-right: 4px;\">Map</label>';
          var select = L.DomUtil.create('select', '', div);
          groups.forEach(function(g, j) {
            var option = L.DomUtil.create('option', '', select);
            option.value = j;
            option.text = g;
          });
          select.onchange = function() { show(parseInt(select.value)); };
          L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
          L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
          return div;
        };
        control.addTo(map);
        show(0);
      }", data = list(groups = names(measures)))
}

# function for adding L lines (colored by line) and stations; lines and stations
# are drawn in their own panes, above the community areas. station_labels are the
# stations' hover labels; other circle marker options (e.g., radius, fillColor)
# are passed through ...
fx_add_rail_layers <- function(map, rail_lines, rail_stations, station_labels, ...) {
  map %>%
    addMapPane("lines", zIndex = 440) %>%
    addMapPane("stations", zIndex = 450) %>%
    addPolylines(
      data = st_transform(rail_lines, crs = 4326),
      weight = 3,
      opacity = 1,
      color = ~unname(pal_line[COLOR]),
      options = pathOptions(pane = "lines"),
      group = "L Lines") %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = st_transform(rail_stations, crs = 4326),
      color = "#fff",
      weight = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      label = station_labels,
      options = pathOptions(pane = "stations"),
      group = "L Stations",
      ...)
}

# vulnerability quintile labels, from least to most vulnerable
vulnerability_labels <- c("Least vulnerable", "Less vulnerable", "Moderate",
                          "More vulnerable", "Most vulnerable")

# function for mapping CCVI by community area with L lines and stations; the
# dropdown list switches between CCVI category and quintiles of selected CCVI
# ranks, and the layer control turns the lines and stations on and off. palette
# is any RColorBrewer palette name (e.g., "YlOrRd", "Blues", "PuRd")
fx_map_ccvi <- function(community_areas_ccvi, rail_lines, rail_stations_ccvi, palette = "YlOrRd") {
  map_data <- st_transform(community_areas_ccvi, crs = 4326)

  # CCVI category and quintiles of selected ranks (1 = least vulnerable)
  rank_quintile <- function(column) {
    factor(vulnerability_labels[map_data[[paste0(column, "_ntile")]]], levels = vulnerability_labels)
  }
  measures <- list(
    "CCVI Category" = map_data$`CCVI Category`,
    "Socioeconomic Status Rank<br>Quintiles" = rank_quintile("Rank - Socioeconomic Status"),
    "Essential Workers Rank<br>Quintiles" = rank_quintile("Rank - Frontline Essential Workers"),
    "Mobility Ratio Rank<br>Quintiles" = rank_quintile("Rank - Cumulative Mobility Ratio"),
    "COVID-19 Incidence Rate Rank<br>Quintiles" = rank_quintile("Rank - COVID-19 Incidence Rate"),
    "COVID-19 Hospitalization Rate Rank<br>Quintiles" = rank_quintile("Rank - COVID-19 Hospital Admission Rate"),
    "COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate Rank<br>Quintiles" = rank_quintile("Rank - COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate"))
  pals <- lapply(measures, function(values)
    colorFactor(palette = palette, domain = values, levels = levels(values), ordered = TRUE))
  # dropdown list names without the legend line break
  names(measures) <- names(pals) <- gsub("<br>", " ", names(measures))

  # station hover labels
  station_labels <- sprintf(
    "<strong>%s</strong><br/>
    <i>Line:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>Community area:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>CCVI Category:</i> %s",
    rail_stations_ccvi$station_name,
    rail_stations_ccvi$station_line,
    rail_stations_ccvi$comarea_name,
    rail_stations_ccvi$`CCVI Category`) %>%
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)

  fx_basemap(map_data) %>%
    fx_add_measure_layers(map_data,
                          measures = measures,
                          pals = pals,
                          labels = fx_ccvi_labels(map_data)) %>%
    fx_add_rail_layers(rail_lines, rail_stations_ccvi, station_labels,
                       radius = 4,
                       fillColor = "#333") %>%
    addLayersControl(
      overlayGroups = c("L Lines", "L Stations"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, position = "topright"))
}

# function for plotting total boardings (all stations) by month; day_type is
# "Weekday", "Saturday" or "Sunday/Holiday"
fx_plot_ridership_by_month <- function(ridership_attributes, day_type = "Weekday") {
  ridership_by_month <- ridership_attributes %>%
    filter(day_type == !!day_type) %>%
    group_by(year_month) %>%
    summarise(rides_total = sum(rides_total), .groups = "drop")

  plot_ly(data = ridership_by_month,
          x = ~year_month,
          y = ~rides_total,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          line = list(color = "#080967", width = 0.5),
          name = 'Total boardings',
          hovertemplate = 'Rides: %{y:,}<extra></extra>') %>%
    fx_plot_layout(y_title = paste0("Total Rail Station Boardings (", day_type, ")"),
                   filename = "cta_rail_boardings_by_month")
}

# function for plotting daily rail boardings (all stations); day_type is "W"
# (weekday), "A" (Saturday) or "U" (Sunday/holiday)
fx_plot_daily_boardings <- function(ridership_daily_boardings, day_type = "W") {
  plot_ly(data = filter(ridership_daily_boardings, day_type == !!day_type),
          x = ~service_date,
          y = ~rail_boardings,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          line = list(color = "#9F1928", width = 0.5),
          name = 'Rail boardings',
          hovertemplate = 'Rail boardings: %{y:,}<extra></extra>') %>%
    fx_plot_layout(y_title = "Daily Rail Station Boardings",
                   filename = "cta_rail_boardings_by_day")
}

# function for tabulating L stations by line and CCVI
fx_table_stations_ccvi <- function(rail_stations_ccvi) {
  rail_stations_ccvi %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(`L Station` = station_name,
           `L Station ID` = station_id,
           `Community Area` = comarea_name,
           `Station Line` = station_line,
           `CCVI Score`,
           `CCVI Category`) %>%
    arrange(`L Station`) %>%
    fx_datatable()
}

# function for plotting COVID-19 cases or deaths by date; layer is "Cases7d" or
# "Deaths7d" (7-day averages), "Cases" or "Deaths" (daily) or "Casescm" or
# "Deathscm" (cumulative)
fx_plot_covid <- function(covid19_cases_summary, layer = "Deaths7d") {
  layer_titles <- c(Cases7d = "COVID-19 Cases (7-day average)",
                    Deaths7d = "COVID-19 Deaths (7-day average)",
                    Cases = "COVID-19 Cases",
                    Deaths = "COVID-19 Deaths",
                    Casescm = "COVID-19 Cases (cumulative)",
                    Deathscm = "COVID-19 Deaths (cumulative)")
  title <- layer_titles[[layer]]

  plot_ly(data = filter(covid19_cases_summary, layer == !!layer),
          x = ~Date,
          y = ~value,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          line = list(color = "#9F1928", width = 0.5),
          name = title,
          hovertemplate = paste0(title, ': %{y:,}<extra></extra>')) %>%
    fx_plot_layout(y_title = title,
                   filename = paste0("covid19_", tolower(layer), "_chicago"))
}

# function for plotting weekday boardings by month and station CCVI category
fx_plot_ridership_by_ccvi <- function(rail_stations_ccvi_ridership) {
  ridership_by_ccvi <- rail_stations_ccvi_ridership %>%
    drop_na(`CCVI Category`) %>%
    group_by(year_month, `CCVI Category`) %>%
    summarise(rides_total = sum(rides_total), .groups = "drop")

  plot_ly(data = ridership_by_ccvi,
          x = ~year_month,
          y = ~rides_total,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          color = ~`CCVI Category`,
          colors = pal_ccvi,
          text = ~`CCVI Category`,
          hovertemplate = '%{text}: %{y:,}<extra></extra>') %>%
    fx_plot_layout(y_title = "Total Weekday Rail Station Boardings",
                   filename = "cta_rail_boardings_by_ccvi")
}

# function for plotting weekday boardings by month and station line; lines is a
# list of line names (e.g., c("Blue", "Red")), all lines by default
fx_plot_ridership_by_line <- function(rail_stations_ccvi_ridership, lines = names(pal_line)) {
  ridership_by_line <- rail_stations_ccvi_ridership %>%
    filter(station_line %in% lines) %>%
    group_by(year_month, station_line) %>%
    summarise(rides_total = sum(rides_total), .groups = "drop")

  plot_ly(data = ridership_by_line,
          x = ~year_month,
          y = ~rides_total,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          color = ~station_line,
          colors = pal_line,
          text = ~station_line,
          hovertemplate = '%{text}: %{y:,}<extra></extra>') %>%
    fx_plot_layout(y_title = "Total Weekday Rail Station Boardings",
                   filename = "cta_rail_boardings_by_line")
}

# function for calculating the change in weekday boardings by station between
# two months (from and to, as "YYYY-MM-DD"); to is the latest month by default and
# from is the same month in 2019 (before the pandemic) by default, so both months
# are in the same season. Only stations on the selected lines are kept.
fx_station_change <- function(ridership_attributes, rail_stations, lines = names(pal_line),
                              from = NULL, to = NULL) {
  to <- if (is.null(to)) max(ridership_attributes$year_month) else as.Date(to)
  from <- if (is.null(from)) lubridate::make_date(2019, lubridate::month(to), 1) else as.Date(from)

  ridership_attributes %>%
    filter(day_type == "Weekday", year_month %in% c(from, to)) %>%
    group_by(station_id) %>%
    summarise(rides_from = sum(rides_total[year_month == from]),
              rides_to = sum(rides_total[year_month == to]),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(net_chg = rides_to - rides_from,
           pct_chg = net_chg / rides_from * 100,
           month_from = from,
           month_to = to) %>%
    filter(is.finite(pct_chg)) %>%
    inner_join(rail_stations %>%
                 select(station_id, station_name, station_line, comarea_id, comarea_name),
               by = "station_id") %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
    filter(station_line %in% lines)
}

# function for mapping the change in boardings by station along with the selected
# lines; stations that lost riders are red and stations that gained riders are
# blue, with larger circles for larger percentage changes. The layer control turns
# the lines, stations and community area CCVI categories (hidden when the map
# opens) on and off.
fx_map_station_change <- function(station_change, rail_lines, community_areas_ccvi,
                                  lines = names(pal_line)) {
  map_data <- st_transform(community_areas_ccvi, crs = 4326)
  month_from <- format(station_change$month_from[1], "%b %Y")
  month_to <- format(station_change$month_to[1], "%b %Y")
  change_colors <- c(Loss = "#d7301f", Gain = "#2171b5")

  # station hover labels
  station_labels <- sprintf(
    "<strong>%s Station</strong><br/>
    <i>Line:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>Community area:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>%s weekday boardings:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>%s weekday boardings:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>Net change:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>Percent change:</i> %0.1f%%<br/>",
    station_change$station_name,
    station_change$station_line,
    station_change$comarea_name,
    month_from, format(station_change$rides_from, big.mark = ","),
    month_to, format(station_change$rides_to, big.mark = ","),
    format(station_change$net_chg, big.mark = ","),
    station_change$pct_chg) %>%
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)

  ccvi_pal <- colorFactor(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = map_data$`CCVI Category`, ordered = TRUE)

  fx_basemap(map_data) %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = map_data,
      fillColor = ~ccvi_pal(`CCVI Category`),
      label = fx_ccvi_labels(map_data),
      weight = 2,
      opacity = 1,
      color = "white",
      dashArray = "3",
      fillOpacity = 0.5,
      group = "CCVI Category") %>%
    addLegend("bottomleft",
              pal = ccvi_pal,
              values = map_data$`CCVI Category`,
              title = "CCVI Category",
              opacity = 1,
              group = "CCVI Category") %>%
    fx_add_rail_layers(filter(rail_lines, COLOR %in% lines),
                       station_change,
                       station_labels,
                       radius = rescale(abs(station_change$pct_chg), to = c(4, 12)),
                       fillColor = unname(change_colors[if_else(station_change$pct_chg < 0, "Loss", "Gain")])) %>%
    addLegend("bottomleft",
              colors = unname(change_colors),
              labels = c("Loss", "Gain"),
              title = paste0("Change in Weekday Boardings<br>", month_from, " to ", month_to),
              opacity = 0.9,
              className = "info legend circle-legend",
              group = "L Stations") %>%
    addLayersControl(
      overlayGroups = c("L Lines", "L Stations", "CCVI Category"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, position = "topright")) %>%
    hideGroup("CCVI Category")
}
```
